svg.aria-label: Timeline of six startups from 2018 to now. Scholarship startup, 2018: Shut down before launch. Never rely on a single source. Logistics startup, 2019: Closed at prototype. Execution matters more than the idea. Leasing startup, 2020: Launched in Covid. Timing can kill a good idea. Homians, 2021 to 23: $40k revenue, 100+ jobs, zero funding. COVID closed it. The Moronss, 2022 to 25: 10,000+ students mentored. Shark Tank India S4 audition final. GeniOS, 2025 to now: $250k ARR, 30+ enterprises piloting. Everything before was the syllabus.
